EcoSense 360 Customer Case Study Transforming Energy Management at the Grand Vista Resort Background The Grand Vista Resort is a 200-room, midscale property located in Orlando, Florida, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Facing rising energy costs, sustainability mandates, and the need to enhance guest comfort, the resort’s management sought a modern solution to optimize energy usage and support their green initiatives. Challenges High and unpredictable energy expenses (over $250,000 annually) Inefficient HVAC and lighting controls leading to wasted energy Difficulty meeting sustainability certification requirements (LEED, ENERGY STAR) Need for real-time monitoring and actionable insights Solution: EcoSense 360 Implementation In early 2025, Grand Vista Resort partnered with Fabrikam to deploy the EcoSense 360 energy management platform. The solution included: Wireless IoT sensors for temperature, occupancy, humidity, and lighting Smart thermostats and automated lighting controls in all guest rooms and public areas Cloud-based management portal for real-time monitoring and analytics Integration with the property’s existing PMS and BMS systems Sustainability reporting tools for certification compliance Results & Impact Energy Savings & ROI Achieved a 32% reduction in annual energy costs (saving $80,000/year) Typical payback period: 2.5 years Operational Efficiency Automated controls reduced manual intervention by 80% Predictive maintenance alerts minimized equipment downtime Sustainability & Compliance Earned LEED Silver and ENERGY STAR certifications within 12 months Reduced carbon footprint by 110 metric tons/year Guest Experience Personalized room comfort settings increased guest satisfaction scores by 18% Real-time occupancy-based controls improved overall comfort and reduced complaints Key Metrics Testimonial "EcoSense 360 has transformed our approach to energy management. We’ve cut costs, improved guest comfort, and achieved our sustainability goals faster than expected. The real-time insights and automation have made our operations more efficient and future-ready." — Jamie Lee, General Manager, Grand Vista Resort

Real-Time Monitoring: Live dashboards for energy consumption, occupancy, and environmental metrics. Automated Controls: AI-driven scheduling and adaptive control of HVAC, lighting, and plug loads. Integration: Native support for major hotel PMS, Open RESTful API, BACnet/IP and Modbus compatibility. Reporting & Analytics: Customizable reports, predictive maintenance alerts, ROI calculators. Sustainability: LEED and ENERGY STAR compliance support, automated demand response participation.

EcoSense 360 Customer Case Study Transforming Energy Management at the Grand Vista Resort Background The Grand Vista Resort is a 200-room, midscale property located in Orlando, Florida, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Facing rising energy costs, sustainability mandates, and the need to enhance guest comfort, the resort’s management sought a modern solution to optimize energy usage and support their green initiatives. Challenges High and unpredictable energy expenses (over $250,000 annually) Inefficient HVAC and lighting controls leading to wasted energy Difficulty meeting sustainability certification requirements (LEED, ENERGY STAR) Need for real-time monitoring and actionable insights Solution: EcoSense 360 Implementation In early 2025, Grand Vista Resort partnered with Fabrikam to deploy the EcoSense 360 energy management platform. The solution included: Wireless IoT sensors for temperature, occupancy, humidity, and lighting Smart thermostats and automated lighting controls in all guest rooms and public areas Cloud-based management portal for real-time monitoring and analytics Integration with the property’s existing PMS and BMS systems Sustainability reporting tools for certification compliance Results & Impact Energy Savings & ROI Achieved a 32% reduction in annual energy costs (saving $80,000/year) Typical payback period: 2.5 years Operational Efficiency Automated controls reduced manual intervention by 80% Predictive maintenance alerts minimized equipment downtime Sustainability & Compliance Earned LEED Silver and ENERGY STAR certifications within 12 months Reduced carbon footprint by 110 metric tons/year Guest Experience Personalized room comfort settings increased guest satisfaction scores by 18% Real-time occupancy-based controls improved overall comfort and reduced complaints Key Metrics Testimonial "EcoSense 360 has transformed our approach to energy management. We’ve cut costs, improved guest comfort, and achieved our sustainability goals faster than expected. The real-time insights and automation have made our operations more efficient and future-ready." — Jamie Lee, General Manager, Grand Vista Resort
